newsitem.title: UK: Home Counties makes profit warning.
newsitem.headline: Home Counties makes profit warning.

text.p: Home Counties Newspapers Holdings Plc said on Friday that annual pretax profit, excluding any profit on the sale of its investment in Classic FM and in The Press Association Ltd, will be in the region of 0.8 million stg.
Shares in the company had slipped 43-1/2p to 217-1/2 by 0828 GMT on the back of the announcment.
It expects the sale of its 3.5 percent stake in Classic FM Radio to GWR Plc to be completed before the year end and produce a profit before tax of around 2.3 million stg.

The company has also reached conditional agreement to sell its shareholding in the Press Association for 420,000 stg. Home Counties expects to maintain last year's dividend by recommending a final dividend for the current year of 3.0p, together with the interim dividend of 2.5p, making total dividends for the year of 5.5p.
The group made pretax profit of 1.7 million stg for the year December 31, 1995.
